findings.title: Adversarial 'could a borne order escape the fiscal chain?' — NO observed escape path in code; one residual edge (out-of-tx flag-write failure) is bounded to log-only degradation

evidence.exception_safety_path: FrontendOrderService:1283-1320 — alloc failure inside DB::transaction sets $allocFailed=true via control flow, transaction rolls back the alloc attempt, THEN outside the closed tx the flag is written via raw DB::table()->update() wrapped in try/catch (Wave M Z5 P1-C pattern). If the flag write itself fails (e.g., DB outage between tx and raw update), error is logged to fiscal channel with explicit event=kiosk.fiscal_alloc_error_flag_write_failed — does NOT propagate to caller, but DOES surface in fiscal log.
evidence.residual_edge_case: Order would be persisted with fiscal_sequence_no=NULL AND fiscal_alloc_error_at=NULL if BOTH alloc AND flag-write fail back-to-back AND the operator does not inspect fiscal logs. The retry-alloc cron would NOT pick it up (filter is `fiscal_alloc_error_at IS NOT NULL` per RetryFiscalAllocCommand.php:22).
evidence.mitigation_strength: P3-info because: (a) two-stage failure requires DB-level outage, (b) fiscal log channel is dedicated (commit 9638a3d81 feat(pos/phase-9-h.3.2)), (c) ZReportService cannot close a branch with detected alloc errors per pre-close gates (commit 3150992a7 GATE-FZH-ALLOC), (d) NF525 verify-chain command will not detect this gap because it walks audit_logs/z_reports HMAC, not orders.fiscal_sequence_no allocation completeness.

findings.verdict: Chain is structurally sound. The two-stage degraded-path edge case is improbable but should be hardened by a complementary sentinel: a periodic SELECT of orders WHERE source_surface IN (kiosk, takeaway) AND payment_status=PaymentStatus::PAID(5) AND fiscal_sequence_no IS NULL AND fiscal_alloc_error_at IS NULL — should always be zero. Recommend filing as V1.0.X backlog (NOT a V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne blocker since fiscal log monitoring is in place).
